exclusions.reason: Requires a Supermemory cloud account and API key (`smfs login`); the filesystem syncs bidirectionally with Supermemory's remote servers and has no documented offline/local-only mode (verified 2026-07-10 from github.com/supermemoryai/smfs). Infeasible without an account -- excluded.

No embedding model runtime already installed; a real pipeline needs a multi-hundred-MB model download plus per-chunk inference. Replaced by the documented simpler bm25-rag baseline (rank-bm25 over 40-line chunks); note a real embedding pipeline's index build cost is strictly HIGHER than bm25's.

fff ships no standalone CLI by design (README: 'FFF is a file search library, not a CLI'); measured instead through its official Python SDK in-process (fff-search 0.9.6), its intended long-lived mode.

latency_statistic.description: Each question runs once per tool (n=1). Reported median ms is the median across heterogeneous questions, not a repeated-trial median of one op. Not an absolute latency gate; accuracy may remain single-shot.
